_comment: CANONICAL model catalog for the WHOLE monorepo (root /models.json): capabilities (window/vision/reasoning/max_output), CLI picker flags (pinnable/group), pricing ($/M tokens; entry price_in/out -> first-matching family rule -> defaults; cache read defaults to 0.1x input, cache write to 1.25x input), and the www chat surface (per-model `www` block: chat/order/description — Go ignores it). Consumers: Go embeds a BYTE-IDENTICAL copy at packages/sdk/go/common/models.json (sync with scripts/sync-models.sh; a guard test fails on drift; api/ re-vendors it), and apps/www derives its entire catalog + calculateCost from THIS file. Edit HERE, run the sync script, never edit the sdk copy directly.

models.label: fable
models._note: Claude Fable 5.1 (Anthropic, claude-fable-5-1). Anthropic's MOST capable widely-released model — state-of-the-art coding/knowledge/vision/computer-use, always-on adaptive thinking, 1M window, 128K out. Supersedes claude-fable-5, which platform.claude.com now lists as legacy. PRICING verified platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing 2026-09-02: $10/$50 per 1M. CACHE READ IS THE ODD ONE: 5.1 (and Mythos 5.1) read cache at 0.025x = $0.25, NOT the 0.1x every other model uses — hence the explicit price_cache_read, without which the 0.1x default bills cache reads at 4x cost. Cache write stays 1.25x ($12.50). Uses the adaptive-thinking path like Opus (rejects manual budget_tokens).

families._note: windows: all gemini-3.x are 1M; pricing: tier-word rules above catch lite/pro, this row is the flash default (gemini-3.8-flash rate)
Fireworks families + any leftover accounts/ path: the glm rate card is the floor so cheap-lane metering is never $0. Replace the kimi rows' pricing when Fireworks publishes real Kimi rates.
Fable/Mythos 5.1 read cache at 0.025x, not the usual 0.1x (platform.claude.com pricing, verified 2026-09-02). Must precede the bare fable/mythos row below.

Fable 5 / Mythos 5 (legacy, still callable and possibly still pinned): $10/$50, cache read 0.1x. Without this row a legacy id matches no pricing family and falls to the $3/$15 defaults — a 5x UNDERCHARGE on output for the most expensive model in the catalog.
Opus 5 $5/$25 per LiteLLM + vendor page (2026-07-27 audit — the old $15/$75 was the pre-4.5 card and overcharged CLI users 3x vs www)
Sonnet 5 $2/$10 — previously hit the $3/$15 defaults row. Re-verified against platform.claude.com 2026-09-02: the scheduled 2026-09-01 raise to $3/$15 was cancelled and this is the standard price.

_search_fees_note: Native in-turn web search bills a PER-REQUEST fee upstream on top of tokens — USD per 1,000 searches, keyed by serving vendor (Response.Backend). Consumed by common.SearchFeeUSD (Go) for the gateway's cost_usd; values must stay floats only (the Go loader parses this object as map[string]float64). VERIFIED 2026-08-06: OpenAI Responses web_search $10/1k calls on reasoning models incl. GPT-5.x (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing — the $25/1k row is web_search_preview on NON-reasoning models, never served here); Anthropic web_search_20250305 $10/1k searches, errored searches not billed, web_fetch has no per-request fee (platform.claude.com/docs web-search-tool); xAI Agent Tools web_search $5/1k invocations (docs.x.ai/developers/pricing — Live Search's $25/1k-sources card died with search_parameters, 410 since 2026-07-18). Gemini absent: google_search grounding is never wired into serving turns (can't coexist with function tools). Fireworks/cheap lane absent: no native search.

defaults._note: unknown ids: a safe non-alarming window baseline + the sonnet rate card

_selection_note: default_model SEEDS the pin exactly once, when no session/workspace/user pin exists; it is then persisted and behaves like any other user choice. It is NOT a fallback, NOT consulted per turn, and NOT a substitution target. utility_model serves internal plumbing only (classify/authorize, compact, shrinkwrap) and may never select, substitute, escalate, downgrade, or steer the pinned model.
